title: Making project knowledge available to AI agents
description: A workspace brought project files and service instructions within reach. The agent could consult existing knowledge, but each task needed only part of the collection.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Loading the instructions an AI task needs
description: Selectable modules supplied the instructions for a task. That established its starting context, but what happened when the task revealed that an instruction was outdated?
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Keeping useful findings after an AI session
description: Task records and folder rules explored what to retain after work. Saving another note could preserve a correction while leaving the old instruction in place. Some findings needed to change existing knowledge.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Updating project knowledge without damaging its documents
description: Different methods searched for related passages and proposed edits. Some edits included the right fact but damaged the document. The change needed review, not just a passing check.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Reviewing changes before they enter a project handbook
description: The handbook flow applies project rules and prepares changes for a person to review. Accepted changes become available to later sessions. That still leaves one question: do they help?
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Testing whether saved context helps an agent answer
description: A trial compared the same questions with different context. Saved knowledge sometimes shortened the search, but also added reading and contained a stale fact. Its value depended on the task.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Using files as the shared state of an app and an agent
description: A task-board prototype used Markdown files as shared state for people and agents.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Making context available through the CLI and MCP
description: CLI and MCP connections made context available outside the original web app.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Keeping agent state outside the agent runtime
description: The framework separated saved knowledge from the software that runs a conversation and its tools.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Packaging reusable workflows and browser procedures
description: Browser procedures and project workflows tested what could remain useful across repeated runs.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Defining folder rules for new information
description: Folder rules explored where new information belongs and when it should change existing files.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Testing context structure with real conversation records
description: Conversation replays exposed fragmented notes and duplicates that small examples missed.
author: Bernat Sampera
